[size=4][u][b]How to use it ?
[/b][/u][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the lastest version
[*]Launch the app
[*]Patch !
[/list]
As easy as one, two, three !

[size=4][u][b]I want to understand how it work
[/b][/u][/size]
That's a good thing ! Let's do this step by step.
Stardew Valley is developed with the Monogame framework, so all the assets (images, sounds and [b]texts[/b]) will be stored in .xnb files.

[list=1]
[*]It will read all .xnb files presents in the X-loc ./static/your_LANG/ folder.
Theses files will replace thoses in your game folder.

[*]It will rename the files that will be replaced in your game folder by adding .xloc_bak at the end of the name.
[*]It will copy the files from X-loc to your game folder.
[*]The [b]RESET[/b] button will rename all the .xloc_bak files to their original names. This will erases translations files.
[/list]
[size=4][u][b]So, can I use it for my XNB mod ?[/b][/u][/size]
It need to be tested, but yes. If you try, let me know !
